source_title: CDOT Transport Permits — 2 CCR 601-4 Ch. 3 (fees per C.R.S. 42-4-510(11)); freight.colorado.gov / COOPR
verify_reasons: 2 CCR 601-4 Ch. 3 fetched this run confirms permit classes and 14'6" height for quad/two-three-axle permits, but sets fees by reference to C.R.S. 42-4-510(11) rather than in-text; the $15 single-trip base + $5.00/axle overweight figures are from CDOT's published summaries — confirm current amounts via COOPR.

Escort thresholds differ by road type (Interstate rear escort/flashing amber over 13'; two-lane 2 escorts over 15') and are published on CDOT's Pilot Escort & Oversize Restriction Map — confirm per route.
Super Loads (Chapter 6 Special) over 17' wide or 200,000 lbs take 6-10 business days for approval.

superload_thresholds.note: Loads over 17' wide or over 200,000 lbs GVW are Super Loads (Chapter 6 Special), requiring 6-10 business days for approval. Annual-permit maximums (e.g. 16' high) are the ceiling above which a Chapter 6 Special is required. Legal height is 14'6" on designated highways (13' non-designated).

width.note: Interstate: 1 rear escort or 1 rear-mounted flashing amber light over 13' wide. Two-lane: 1 escort over 13'
two-lane: 2 escorts (or 1 front escort + rear flashing amber) over 15' wide

height.note: 1 escort with high pole over 16' high (legal height is 14'6" on designated highways)

length.note: 1 escort over 85' on some two- and four-lane segments
1 escort over 110' (two-lane) or 115' (four or more lanes)

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip permit $15 base; if overweight add $5.00 per axle (e.g. 6-axle over 80,000 lbs = $45). Oversize-only single trip is the $15 base. Super Loads (Chapter 6 Special) quoted separately. Fees set by C.R.S. 42-4-510(11).
single_trip.note: Single-trip permit valid 5 days; obtained through COOPR online.

annual.note: Annual permits available up to Annual-permit dimensional maximums (e.g. 16' high); fees per 2 CCR 601-4 / C.R.S. 42-4-510(11).

movement_restrictions: Loads over 12' but not over 14' wide require an escort for night running
Metropolitan commute-hour, holiday and adverse-weather restrictions may apply per permit and route
notes: Legal height 14'6" designated highways / 13' non-designated; width 8'6"; GVW 80,000 lbs Interstate / 85,000 lbs other roads.
Overweight fee is per-axle, so a gross-weight-only verdict is indicative — confirm axle count via COOPR.
State-level rules only; local permits and bridge-specific engineering out of scope.
